The repository inspection is complete. The full picture of GraphQL usage and public API surfaces is now clear.

No GraphQL schema or dependencies were found. The public API surface is gRPC protobuf services with HTTP gateway REST endpoints at `/api/v1/*` and `/file/*`, plus Connect RPC at `/memos.api.v1.*`. Browser clients use connect-web with binary format.

OpenAPI is generated from protobuf definitions at `proto/gen/openapi.yaml` and embedded via `proto/openapi_embed.go` for MCP use.

Other public endpoints include file attachments and avatars under `/file/`, RSS feeds at `/explore/rss.xml` and `/u/:username/rss.xml`, MCP at `/mcp`, SSE at `/api/v1/sse`, and health at `/healthz`.

Protobuf definitions live in `proto/api/v1/*.proto` for the public API, while `proto/store/*.proto` defines internal models. Generated code appears in `proto/gen/api/v1/*` and `web/src/types/proto/*`.

Registration paths are `server/server.go` for the main hub, `srver/router/api/v1/v1.go` for REST and Connect gateway setup, `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` for Connect handlers, and `*_service.go` files for service implementations. Generation is driven by `proto/buf.gen.yaml`.
